-- Build the full categorization
WITH fan_sls AS (
    -- Calculate SLS per fan from support records
    SELECT 
        i.interact_fan_pivot as fan_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(s.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix', '0')::int + 
            COALESCE(s.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs', '0')::int + 
            COALESCE(s.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt', '0')::int) as sls
    FROM interactions i
    JOIN supportandfeedback s ON s.support_interact_pivot = i.activity_reg
    GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot
),
fan_churn AS (
    -- Get churn_flag per fan
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.member_fan_pivot as fan_id,
        r.churn_flag
    FROM retentionandinfluence r
    JOIN engagement e ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engage_member_pivot = m.member_reg
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN fs.sls > 10 AND fc.churn_flag = 'High' THEN 'High-Maintenance AND At-Risk'
        WHEN fs.sls > 10 AND fc.churn_flag != 'High' THEN 'High-Maintenance Only'
        WHEN fs.sls <= 10 AND fc.churn_flag = 'High' THEN 'At-Risk Only'
        ELSE 'Neither'
    END as fan_group,
    COUNT(f.user_registry) as fan_count
FROM fans f
LEFT JOIN fan_sls fs ON f.user_registry = fs.fan_id
LEFT JOIN fan_churn fc ON f.user_registry = fc.fan_id
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN fs.sls > 10 AND fc.churn_flag = 'High' THEN 'High-Maintenance AND At-Risk'
        WHEN fs.sls > 10 AND fc.churn_flag != 'High' THEN 'High-Maintenance Only'
        WHEN fs.sls <= 10 AND fc.churn_flag = 'High' THEN 'At-Risk Only'
        ELSE 'Neither'
    END
ORDER BY fan_group;
